text: {"lessons":["My account rose and fell noticeably while I mostly held, so I should expect volatility and avoid making decisions based on one month's return.","Selling Stock A after a large gain did not protect the whole portfolio from later declines; I should judge each holding by my plan, not just its recent gain or loss.","I should make future buys and sells deliberately, keep enough cash for flexibility, and stay focused on steady progress toward my ten-year apartment goal."]}
